title: Scaled Relative Graphs in Normed Spaces
summary: The paper extends the Scaled Relative Graph (SRG) framework of Ryu, Hannah, and Yin from Hilbert spaces to normed spaces. Our extension replaces the inner product with a regular pairing, whose asymmetry gives rise to directional angles and, in turn, directional SRGs. Directional SRGs are shown to provide geometric containment tests certifying key operator properties, including contraction and monotonicity.
